text: {"kind":"final","content":"{\"answer\":\"Root Route’s data shows current on-time 71.0% of deliveries (deliveries 48340, late 14019). It records penaltiesUsd 872460, handlingCostUsd 476646, atRiskAccounts 9, atRiskRevenueUsd 14200000, and pre-pickup share 67.3%.\\n\\nWhat routing alone can fix (evidence): replay “Route overruns only” gives on-time 73.6% (lateAvoided 1279, costAvoided 113347). Combining carrier lanes + routes gives on-time 80.4% (lateAvoided 4523, costAvoided 409897).\\n\\nWhat pre-pickup fixes can achieve (evidence): “Address + cut-off + stock” gives on-time 87.8% (lateAvoided 8112, costAvoided 801412). The full programme variants reach higher still (for example the phase2 full fix shows on-time 96.3% in the replay results).\\n\\nSuggestion (from the data, not a decision): the data points to greater returns from fixing pre-pickup causes than from routing alone: “Address + cut-off + stock” (on-time 87.8%, lateAvoided 8112) gives a higher on-time rate than carrier lanes + routes (on-time 80.4%, lateAvoided 4523). Combining the pre-pickup fixes with routing gives still higher on-time in the replayed scenarios. The decision stays with Halcyon.\",\"refused\":false}"}
